name: softmax_gpt2_124m
description: Softmax sequencer over a row of at most 256 scores: max pass, exponential pass with sum, one reciprocal, normalising multiply

derivation.rule: capacity is one attention row tile; the score and weight formats come from the exponential unit and the normalising shift from the reciprocal, so a change to either changes this block

ports.name: n
ports.desc: number of scores in the row

ports.name: s_data
ports.desc: score, registered read, one cycle after s_addr

ports.name: w_valid
ports.desc: a normalised weight is on w_data

ports.name: w_index
ports.desc: which score the weight belongs to

behavior: start begins a row of n scores.
The first pass reads every score and keeps the maximum, because the exponential is only defined for non-positive arguments and subtracting the row maximum is what guarantees that.
The second pass reads them again, feeds score minus maximum to the exponential unit, buffers each result and accumulates their sum.
The sum then goes through the reciprocal unit once. A divide per weight would be absurd.
The third pass multiplies each buffered exponential by that reciprocal and emits it with w_valid.
Every read is registered, so addresses lead data by one cycle throughout.
